name: Maskbreak Fraud Detection API
description: Real-time fraud, VPN, residential-proxy, datacenter, antidetect-browser, and bot detection. Use live visitor evaluation for network and device signals; bare-IP lookups have more limited coverage. Plans (since 2026-09-30): Free — 10,000 visitor checks a month, up to 1,000 an hour, no credit card; Starter, Growth and Scale from €29 to €299 a month (excluding VAT); Enterprise by contract (https://maskbreak.com/pricing). A visitor check is one /v1/evaluate call; /v1/lookup has its own monthly allowance of 10× the plan's visitor checks. A used-up monthly allowance answers 429 with code monthly_quota_exceeded. Processing time is returned per evaluation; end-to-end latency depends on the request and available intelligence sources.
